title: Dual-stack + `0.0.0.0/0` / `::/0` CIDR policy: a ROLLBACK to 1.14 may deny existing connections

detection.reason: Cilium network policies (CiliumNetworkPolicy / CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy) are not collected — run the command to list the affected policies

quote: Downgrading from Cilium 1.15.y or later to Cilium 1.14.x or earlier may trigger this problem.
remediation: The upgrade to 1.15 is not affected. If you may have to roll back to 1.14, know that on dual-stack clusters the policies the command lists (toCIDR/toCIDRSet covering a full range) can deny ESTABLISHED connections after the downgrade until the application reconnects; new connections are not impacted.
verifyCommand: kubectl get ciliumnetworkpolicies.cilium.io,ciliumclusterwidenetworkpolicies.cilium.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $p | [(.spec // empty), (.specs[]?)] | map(((.ingress // []) + (.egress // []) + (.ingressDeny // []) + (.egressDeny // []))[]) | select(any(.[]; [(.toCIDR // [])[], ((.toCIDRSet // [])[] | .cidr // empty)] | any(. == "0.0.0.0/0" or . == "::/0"))) | $p | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a policy matching a full IP range

title: CiliumNetworkPolicy can no longer match `reserved:init` labels

detection.reason: Cilium network policies (CiliumNetworkPolicy / CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy) are not collected — run the command to list the affected policies

quote: `CiliumNetworkPolicy` cannot match the `reserved:init` labels any more.
remediation: Convert every CiliumNetworkPolicy that matches `reserved:init` into a CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy before upgrading (same note as 1.14.2; a 1.14.0/1.14.1 install meets it here).
verifyCommand: kubectl get ciliumnetworkpolicies.cilium.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(tostring | test("reserved:init")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a namespaced policy that still matches reserved:init

title: External workloads no longer infer the cluster name and ID

detection.reason: external workloads run outside the cluster

quote: Cluster name and ID are no longer automatically inferred by Cilium agents running on external workloads.
remediation: If this cluster's name or ID is not the default, regenerate the external-workload install script with Cilium CLI ≥ v0.15.8 (it passes both explicitly) before upgrading the VMs.
verifyCommand: kubectl get ciliumexternalworkloads.cilium.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is an external workload that needs an explicit cluster name and ID

title: `enable-endpoint-routes` now forces `enable-local-node-route` off

detection.reason: cilium-config keys only (names, never values): an option passed on the agent or operator command line (extraArgs) or in a ConfigMap of another name is not scanned; only the presence of enable-endpoint-routes is read — its value decides

quote: `enable-endpoint-routes` now automatically sets `enable-local-node-route` to false
remediation: With per-endpoint routes enabled, 1.15 drops the local node route automatically; host routing that relied on it (custom node routes, hand-written iptables) must use the per-endpoint routes instead.
verifyCommand: kubectl get configmap -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name == "cilium-config") | .metadata.namespace as $ns | .data | to_entries[] | select(.key | test("^(enable-endpoint-routes|enable-local-node-route)$")) | "\($ns)/cilium-config \(.key)=\(.value)"'  # enable-endpoint-routes=true is affected

title: L7 visibility Pod annotation `policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility` no longer supported
quote: L7 visibility using Pod annotations (`policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility`) is no longer supported.
remediation: Replace the annotation on the Pods named with an L7 network policy that covers the same ports (that is what produces L7 flows in Hubble from 1.15); the annotation is ignored, so L7 visibility for these Pods silently stops.

title: Gateway API: install the v1 CRDs (GatewayClass, Gateway, HTTPRoute)

detection.reason: reads the installed Gateway API CRDs' served versions

quote: If you are using Gateway API, please make sure that new v1 CRDs are installed.
remediation: The CRDs named do not serve `v1`. Install the Gateway API v1.0+ CRDs before upgrading, then move GatewayClass, Gateway and HTTPRoute manifests from `v1beta1` to `v1`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '(.items | map({key: .metadata.name, value: ([.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] | join(","))}) | from_entries) as $c | ["gatewayclasses","gateways","httproutes","grpcroutes","tlsroutes","referencegrants"][] | (. + ".gateway.networking.k8s.io") as $n | "\($n) \($c[$n] // "MISSING")"'  # need v1 on the first three, v1alpha2 on grpcroutes/tlsroutes, v1beta1 on referencegrants; MISSING disables Gateway API

gate.reason: only clusters with Cilium's Gateway API support enabled read these CRDs

title: Gateway API: Cilium 1.15 also requires grpcroute and tlsroute CRDs serving `v1alpha2`

detection.reason: reads the installed Gateway API CRDs' served versions; a CRD that is not installed at all is not judged — the command lists it

quote: If you are using Gateway API, please make sure that new v1 CRDs are installed.
remediation: Cilium 1.15's operator checks GatewayClass/Gateway/HTTPRoute at `v1`, GRPCRoute and TLSRoute at `v1alpha2` and ReferenceGrant at `v1beta1`; if any is missing or does not serve that version it logs "Required GatewayAPI resources are not found" and Gateway API stops reconciling. Install the Gateway API v1.0 EXPERIMENTAL-channel CRDs (the standard channel has no GRPCRoute/TLSRoute) before upgrading.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '(.items | map({key: .metadata.name, value: ([.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] | join(","))}) | from_entries) as $c | ["gatewayclasses","gateways","httproutes","grpcroutes","tlsroutes","referencegrants"][] | (. + ".gateway.networking.k8s.io") as $n | "\($n) \($c[$n] // "MISSING")"'  # need v1 on the first three, v1alpha2 on grpcroutes/tlsroutes, v1beta1 on referencegrants; MISSING disables Gateway API

gate.reason: only clusters with Cilium's Gateway API support enabled read these CRDs

title: DSR with Geneve in native routing no longer implies `tunnel-protocol=geneve`

detection.reason: the option's VALUE is not collected (cilium-config ships key names only)

quote: The tunnel protocol is no longer automatically set to `geneve` when Cilium is configured in native routing mode and DSR mode with Geneve is enabled.
remediation: If cilium-config has `routing-mode: native` and `bpf-lb-dsr-dispatch: geneve`, set `tunnel-protocol: geneve` (Helm `tunnelProtocol=geneve`) explicitly before upgrading; otherwise the agent picks VXLAN and DSR traffic breaks.
verifyCommand: kubectl get configmap -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name == "cilium-config") | .data | to_entries[] | select(.key | test("^(routing-mode|bpf-lb-dsr-dispatch|tunnel-protocol)$")) | "\(.key)=\(.value)"'  # native + geneve dispatch without tunnel-protocol=geneve is affected

title: `CILIUM_PREPEND_IPTABLES_CHAIN` env var renamed to `CILIUM_PREPEND_IPTABLES_CHAINS`

detection.reason: container env NAMES are not collected

quote: The `CILIUM_PREPEND_IPTABLES_CHAIN` environment variable has been renamed to `CILIUM_PREPEND_IPTABLES_CHAINS`
remediation: Rename the variable in the agent DaemonSet (extraEnv) — the old name is ignored, so the agent falls back to appending its iptables chains.
verifyCommand: kubectl get daemonset -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]?; .image | test("(^|/)cilium/cilium([:@]|$)"))) | .metadata.namespace as $ns | .metadata.name as $n | .spec.template.spec.containers[].env[]? | select(.name == "CILIUM_PREPEND_IPTABLES_CHAIN") | "\($ns)/\($n)"'  # each row is an agent still using the old name

title: BPF masquerade without its requirements now fails agent start instead of falling back to iptables

detection.reason: the option's VALUE is not collected (cilium-config ships key names only)

quote: it will fail to initialize and will log an error instead of silently fall back to iptables based masquerading.
remediation: If cilium-config has `enable-bpf-masquerade: "true"`, confirm BPF NodePort (kube-proxy replacement) and socket load-balancing are enabled before upgrading; otherwise the 1.15 agent does not start on any node.
verifyCommand: kubectl get configmap -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name == "cilium-config") | .data | to_entries[] | select(.key | test("^(enable-bpf-masquerade|kube-proxy-replacement|bpf-lb-sock|enable-node-port)$")) | "\(.key)=\(.value)"'  # bpf masquerade=true needs kube-proxy-replacement and socket LB

title: `tunnel` option removed — routing mode falls back to the default

detection.reason: cilium-config keys only (names, never values): an option passed on the agent or operator command line (extraArgs) or in a ConfigMap of another name is not scanned; the 1.13 chart writes tunnel on every install (the 1.14 chart rewrites it), so on a 1.13 cluster the key alone does not mean it was hand-set

quote: The `tunnel` option (deprecated in Cilium 1.14) has been removed.
remediation: cilium-config still sets `tunnel`, which the 1.15 agent ignores (its default is `routing-mode: tunnel`). Helm-managed: upgrading through 1.14 rewrites the key into `routing-mode` / `tunnel-protocol` for you, but the 1.15 chart refuses to render while your values still set `tunnel` — move it to `routingMode` / `tunnelProtocol`. Hand-managed cilium-config: replace it before upgrading: `tunnel: disabled` → `routing-mode: native`; `tunnel: vxlan|geneve` → `routing-mode: tunnel` + `tunnel-protocol: vxlan|geneve`. A cluster that ran native routing through `tunnel: disabled` switches to VXLAN encapsulation otherwise.
verifyCommand: kubectl get configmap -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name == "cilium-config") | .metadata.namespace as $ns | .data | to_entries[] | select(.key | test("^(tunnel)$")) | "\($ns)/cilium-config \(.key)=\(.value)"'  # each row is an option still set in cilium-config
coversNotes: Helm Options: Value `tunnel` was deprecated in Cilium 1.14
